channel.title: The Daily Dot - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Dot (dailydot.com)

item.title: Jools LeBron speaks on her chaotic viral journey
item.description: Fame took Jools LeBron from "demure" to drug dependent...to sober and determined.

item.title: Are we doomed? AI slop videos of cheating fruit are taking over social media
item.description: The latest social media craze has users recreating and reacting to soap opera-style videos of anthropomorphic fruits cheating on each other.

item.title: SNL UK's inaugural Weekend Update hosts take on Prince Andrew
item.description: "If you're watching, Andrew, hello. You're not going to like this next bit. Also, I'm older than I look."

item.title: CNN attempts a more casual, podcast-like set only to get roasted online
item.description: CNN's recently debuted look for its on-air news anchors is causing much discussion online, where many are asking if it's an attempt to look more like a podcast.

item.title: Fans rally behind the first Asian Marvel superhero—and it's not Simu Liu
item.description: A movie-themed X account has sparked a lot of commotion online after it said Simu Liu was the "first Asian lead" in Marvel's cinematic universe.

item.title: The internet responds with Chappell Roan memes to the alleged snub of Jude Law's daughter
item.description: After a recent story broke about Chappell Roan allegedly siccing her security guard on a young fan who smiled at her at breakfast, people started calling to cancel the singer.

item.title: 'I can't imagine I'm making my flight': Travelers complain about long TSA lines as shutdown continues
item.description: Travelers at U.S. airports experiencing lengthy TSA lines have been taking to social media to complain and draw awareness to the problem.

item.title: Gypsy Rose's Joke About Killing Her Mom During Natalie Reynolds Collab Divides Audiences
item.description: Gypsy Rose, the woman convicted of second-degree murdering her own mother, is back on TikTok with Natalie Reynolds to joke about it.

item.title: ‘Hawk Tuah Girl’ finally speaks out on failed crypto venture
item.description: After a year and a half out of the public eye, ‘Hawk Tuah Girl’ Hailey Welch broke her silence, describing her side of the viral crypto crash.

item.title: Madonna Confirms Julia Garner Will Star In Future Biopic
item.description: Madonna and Julia Garner are using their downtime between shooting for The Studio to co-promote other projects in Venice.

item.title: Lo-Fi Girl collabs with The Sims, but the timing couldn't be worse
item.description: The Lo-Fi Girl has collaborated with The Sims 4 for a Sims-themed lo-fi album — but it didn't get the reaction they were expecting.

item.title: Barry Keoghan Says Harassment Makes Him Want To Stay Inside
item.description: Actor Barry Keoghan reported in a recent interview that online hate and harassment has made him reluctant to go outside or work anymore.

item.title: Players agree that 'Pokopia' is chill—except for one yucky feature
item.description: Pokopia players are able to transport water via a feature known as waterscaping, but one TikToker posited an important nuance.

item.title: John Cena hugs fan battling cancer and shares words of encouragement
item.description: John Cena booked it into the crowd to hug a fan with stage four cancer.
